::: {.take-home}
```{=latex}
\fontsize{44pt}{55pt}\selectfont\mdseries
```
**Sharp** means narrow bands. **Honest** means bands that cover the truth about as often as claimed. **Robust** means the fit rarely fails. No tool gives all three: the best choice depends on the data and on how far ahead we predict.
:::

::: {.problem}
Plants are measured at few, uneven times, yet we need smooth curves, growth rates and honest uncertainty.
:::

::: {.why-it-matters}
Growth curves and rates guide breeding and management. A tool too sure misleads; one too vague gives no answer.
:::

::: {.claim fig="figs/claim1.pdf" heading="In simulation, thinner data cost coverage or width: on sparse designs no tool keeps both."}
Thinnest design: GP+L and GP cover 1.00 and 1.00, with bands 114% and 374% of K wide. GF (log) covers 0.61 at 14% of K.
:::

::: {.claim fig="figs/claim2.pdf" heading="On real plants, the closest tool depends on how far past the last reading we predict."}
One genotype (C24), scored only on left-out readings. Last reading left out: repeat-last 0.059, GP+L 0.062. Days 36 to 44, after a Day 30 cut: GF (log) 0.59 (14 of 802 failed), GP+L 0.68, SPL 2.34, GP 2.49.
:::

::: {.claim fig="figs/claim3.pdf" heading="As we predict further ahead, intervals widen, but only some tools keep catching the data."}
Longest horizon: share of left-out readings inside the 90% interval, failed fits counted as misses. GP+L 99%, GF (log) 88%, GP 85% (the widest bands), SPL 54%. Plain natural-scale arms: far too narrow.
:::

::: {.next}
```{=latex}
\fontsize{34pt}{44pt}\selectfont
```
Next: how few plants need dense measuring? We will test borrowing their information for sparsely measured relatives and neighbours, adding genetics and spatial information, starting with GP+L and spline refinements.
:::

::: {.methods}
```{=latex}
\fontsize{21pt}{26pt}\selectfont
```
**GF** growth-function fit by nls: best of monomolecular, 3- and 4-parameter logistic and Gompertz (AIC). **SPL** ASReml smoothing spline. **GP** frozen Gaussian process, no mean function. **GP+L** GP with logistic mean. **Hold-out** H1 last reading left out, H2 last two, H3 all after Day 30.
:::
